PDF Fast Polyhedral Cell Sorting for Interactive Rendering of Unstructured ...
Abstract Direct volume rendering based on projective methods works by projecting, in visibility order, the polyhedral cells of a mesh onto the image plane, and incrementally compositing the cell's color and opacity into the final image.
